Moses' Cushite wife provokes Miriam and Aaron's challenge in Numbers 12:1. The rhetorical question 'Can the Cushite change his skin?' (Jer 13:23) appeals to the Cushites' distinctive dark complexion as something visibly inherent. French and German renderings ('Éthiopien,' 'Kuschiter') preserve the geographic link to the classical world's Aithiopia."

The feminine כֻּשִׁית appears only for Moses' wife (Num 12:1).
